details: For finite binary concept classes, extended teaching dimension equals the star number.
proof: Theorem 13 of the cited paper proves the finite-domain form $\mathrm{XTD}(\mathcal H,m)=\min\{\mathrm S(\mathcal H),m\}$. Taking $m$ to be the finite effective domain gives $\mathrm{XTD}(\mathcal H)=\mathrm S(\mathcal H)$.
name: Extended Teaching Dimension / Star Number
